items.headline: Zandvoort's farewell turns wild — Norris wins as Verstappen crashes out on Lap 1
items.body: In the final F1 race ever at Zandvoort, Lando Norris held off Kimi Antonelli to win a dramatic Dutch GP — while home hero Max Verstappen lost the rear and slammed the wall on the opening lap, bringing out the red flag. Antonelli briefly grabbed the lead on the restart before Norris reeled him back in.
items.say: Did you catch the Dutch GP? Verstappen crashing out on lap one at his home race in the very last Zandvoort was brutal — and Norris just kept his cool.

items.headline: History in Shanghai — Team Spirit win The International again to become the first three-time champs
items.body: Team Spirit beat TEAM VISION 3-2 in a five-game grand final to lift the Aegis of Champions once more. Stars Yatoro and Collapse are now the first players ever to win Dota's biggest prize three times — this one on top of 2021 and 2023.
items.say: Team Spirit just won The International for a THIRD time — first squad to ever do it. In Dota that's basically the equivalent of a three-peat at the World Cup.

items.headline: Late, late City — Gvardiol strikes in stoppage time to rescue Maresca's opener
items.body: Bournemouth stunned the Etihad through Marcus Tavernier and led deep into the game, but Manchester City roared back — Marc Guéhi headed the equalizer and Joško Gvardiol poked home the winner in the 91st minute for a 2-1 comeback. A dramatic first win of the new era for boss Enzo Maresca.
items.say: City left it to literally the last minute today — down to Bournemouth, then two late goals to nick it 2-1. New manager, same drama.

items.headline: Leadoff bomb, walk-off bomb — Arozarena bookends a game the Mariners had no business winning
items.body: Randy Arozarena homered on the very first pitch of the game, robbed a home run with a leaping catch, then crushed a two-run walk-off blast to sink the Cubs 5-4. He's the first player in Mariners history to lead off and walk off with homers in the same game.
items.say: Arozarena homered on the first pitch of the game AND hit the walk-off to end it — plus a home-run-robbing catch in between. Best all-around day you'll ever see.

items.headline: Spider-Man swings past $2 billion — the second-fastest movie ever to get there
items.body: 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day' crossed $2 billion worldwide in just 17 days, trailing only 'Avengers: Endgame' to the mark. It's already 2026's biggest movie, having blown past 'Toy Story 5' and posted the biggest domestic opening in history at $360M.
items.say: Spider-Man just hit two billion dollars — only Endgame got there faster. That new one is an absolute monster at the box office.

items.headline: Madonna and Taylor lead the VMA nominations — and Madonna's back in the big category after 22 years
items.body: The 2026 MTV VMA nominations are out: Madonna leads with 11, Taylor Swift has 9, and Ariana Grande and Sabrina Carpenter grabbed 7 apiece. Taylor's 'The Fate of Ophelia' and Madonna's 'Confessions II — The Film' are both up for Video of the Year ahead of the Sept. 27 show.
items.say: The VMA noms dropped — Madonna's leading with eleven, first Video of the Year nod in over 20 years. Who are you pulling for, Taylor or Madonna?

items.headline: The K-pop kings are back — BIGBANG launch a 31-show world stadium tour for their 20th
items.body: BIGBANG are celebrating 20 years with their biggest run in ages — 31 stadium shows across Asia, North America, Europe and Australia. For a group whose 'Fantastic Baby' and 'Bang Bang Bang' videos each topped 600 million views, it's a proper reunion moment.
items.say: BIGBANG announced a 31-city stadium tour for their 20th anniversary — the group that basically kicked open the door for K-pop worldwide. Kind of a huge deal.

items.headline: Gaming's biggest week starts Tuesday — Gamescom Opening Night Live goes live
items.body: Geoff Keighley's Gamescom Opening Night Live kicks off Tuesday (11am PT), streaming free on YouTube, Twitch and Steam. Confirmed so far: a fresh look at 'Final Fantasy VII Revelation' — the finale of the Remake trilogy — plus a new Witcher 3 DLC, with the usual pile of surprise reveals.
items.say: Gamescom's big showcase is Tuesday — they're teasing new Final Fantasy VII and Witcher 3 stuff. Perfect excuse to see what's coming this fall.
